summary: Autozi Internet Technology (Global) Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting a private placement of up to 50 million Class A ordinary shares at $0.6 per share for aggregate proceeds of ~$30 million to non-U.S. investors under Regulation S. The purchase price may be paid in fiat or cryptocurrency at the company's discretion. The transaction is expected to close in Q3 2026. No board recommendation or advisor is named. This is a capital-raising PIPE, not a special-situation event.
